Name: SF - Mystical Buildings
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/fc6Gt4t.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Mystical Buildings is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url] pack which adds several new custom buildings which can be utilized daily (or at custom intervals).

Buildings can set their own individual cooldown (in days) by editing the mod's config or by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]. Each building by default uses a cooldown of 1 game day.

[img]https://imgur.com/uUDpPUg.png[/img]


[/size][img]https://imgur.com/S3tmnAS.png[/img]
[b][size=5]Quizzical Statue[/size][/b]
[size=3]This statue will ask you daily questions about the bachelors and bachelorettes and what items they love / hate. Answer it correctly and you'll be rewarded generously![/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/zxU6Vmd.gif[/img]


[b][size=5]Statue of Greed[/size][/b]
[size=3]This hungry statue will offer to double any given items, though it may just end up eating what you give it![/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/TKXSg8r.gif[/img]


[b][size=5]Crumbling Mineshaft[/size][/b]
[size=3]This not-so-stable mineshaft will lead you into cavern with a vast wealth of ores. However you will only have a small amount of time before the mineshaft starts to collapse!

[b]Warning[/b]: Any items dropped in the unstable cavern [b]will be lost[/b] if not picked up before the timer runs out.
[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/m9eq934.png[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/Kwzj4ph.gif[/img]


[b][size=5]Obelisk of Weather[/size][/b]
[size=3]This obelisk lets you change tomorrow's weather according to your wish.[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/njCOUNM.gif[/img]


[b][size=5]Orb of Reflection[/size][/b]
[size=3]A mystical orb that gives the odd bit of wisdom, along with a related buff that lasts all day.[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/LoMnIJr.gif[/img]

[b][size=5]Phantom Clock[/size][/b]
[size=3]This almost ethereal clock can spin back the hands of time, if you can give a Rusty Cog. Any progress made (crops, friendship, etc.) will be kept.[/size]

[b]Note[/b]: By default the clock will go back 7 days, but that can be changed via the config file.

[img]https://imgur.com/KdRi2jR.gif[/img]



[img]https://imgur.com/fP5yPeU.png[/img]
[b][size=3]How do I build these?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Visit the Wizard's Tower and utilize the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Wizard's_Tower#Buildings]buildings book[/url]﻿ to construct them.[/size]
[*][size=3]You can utilize the wizard's building menu after getting the [spoiler][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Magic_Ink]Magic Ink[/url][/spoiler][/size]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Can I build more than one of these?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Each Mystical Building can only be built once per player. If deconstructed, you may build it again.[/size]
[/list]

Source code is [url=https://github.com/Floogen/MysticalBuildings]available here[/url]﻿.
